import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import xgboost as xgb

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Feature Engineering: Character n-grams
vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 3), lowercase=True, fit=False
)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"]).toarray()
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"]).toarray()
ids_train = train_df["id"].values
ids_test = test_df["id"].values
classes = np.unique(train_df["author"].values)
class_to_idx = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(classes)}
idx_to_class = {i: cls for i, cls in enumerate(classes)}

y_train = np.array([class_to_idx[cls] for cls in train_df["author"]])

# Stratified Split for Validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val, ids_tr, ids_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, ids_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Initial Model (Holdout)
model_partial = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="multi:softprob",
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model_partial.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
y_pred_prob_partial = model_partial.predict_proba(X_val)

# Compute Strict Log Loss according to instructions
eps = 1e-15
p_clipped = np.clip(y_pred_prob_partial, eps, 1 - eps)
# Log loss formula: -1/N sum(sum(y_ij * log(p_ij)))
# Since y is 0/1 hot encoded, this simplifies to averaging the negative log prob of true class
N = y_val.shape[0]
log_losses_val = -np.mean(np.sum(y_val * np.log(p_clipped), axis=1))
val_metric = float(log_losses_val)

print(f"{val_metric:.6f}")

# Retrain on Full Data for Submission
X_all = X_train
y_all = y_train
model_final = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="multi:softprob",
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model_final.fit(X_all, y_all)

# Generate Test Predictions
test_probs = model_final.predict_proba(X_test)
test_probs_clipped = np.clip(test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)

# Map to Author Names
predictions_df = pd.DataFrame(
    test_probs_clipped, columns=["P_" + c for c in classes], index=ids_test
)
submission_data = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids_test})
for idx, cls in enumerate(classes):
    submission_data[f"{cls}"] = predictions_df["P_" + cls].values

# Rename columns to match submission format EAP, HPL, MWS
sub_columns = [col for col in submission_data.columns if col != "id"]
sorted_columns = sorted(sub_columns)
submission_data.columns = ["id"] + sorted_columns

# Reorder specifically to EAP, HPL, MWS if desired (Sample had EAP, HPL, MWS)
final_cols = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
submission_data = submission_data[
    [c for c in final_cols if c in submission_data.columns]
]

submission_data.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
